title: fix(types): /actions answers a driver string code as the /data door's fault
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X1nhftM2hZHHvqk2GLFyVTN)_

domain:server#3 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5nBSzc6ktJyjdFcDb3

Fixes #31317

Clause-②: no (a driver fault inside an action body moves from 400 VALIDATION_ERROR to the 5xx fault /data already answers: a status/code correction on an error answer, not a widening; measured from the real diff, no accepted input and no success shape changes)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:动作体里抛出带驱动自身字符串 code 的错误(如 `SQLITE_BUSY`、`ECONNREFUSED`)且没有声明 HTTP 状态时,`POST /api/v1/actions` 现在回 `/api/v1/data` 同样的服务器故障(`SQLITE_BUSY` 是 `500 DATABASE_ERROR` / `Internal data error`),不再回 `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` 并把驱动 code 放进 `declaredCode`。MCP 的 `run_action` / `resume_run` 跟着 `/actions` 一起变。
- 为什么改:同一个数据库故障在两个门上一个说「客户端请求错了」、一个说「服务器出错」,而且 `/actions` 把驱动名和驱动原文暴露给了调用方;重试、告警、网关错误率都看不到这类故障。
- 风险与回滚:只动「没声明状态、code 不在 ADR-0112 封闭词表里、且 `/data` 判为 5xx」这一类;封闭 code(`RECORD_LOCKED` 等)、裸 `Error`、带状态的抛错、沙箱动作体的带 code 拒绝都照旧是 400(有对照 pin)。代价:进程内动作处理器抛自造 code 且不带状态,会变成 500 并丢 code(#12509 裁决的既定代价,带上状态即可保留)。runtime 559 个测试文件、mcp 60 个、types 38 个全绿。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/types/src/actions-door-answer.ts` 新增的 Arm 6(判定只用 `demotedDeclaredCode` + `/data` 的 `mapDataError`,不另抄一份),`packages/runtime/src/domains/actions-driver-code-fault-parity.test.ts`,`packages/mcp/src/mcp-coded-refusal.test.ts` 改动的那一行。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/actions-driver-code-fault-parity.test.ts`(先 build `@objectstack/types`),预期 7 条全绿;其中 3 条在 main 上是红的(`expected 400 to be 500`)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/types` `actionsDoorAnswerOf`**: a new arm between the unexpected-fault arm and the 400 rejection. When a throw that declared no status spells a `.code` that is not a closed ADR-0112 code, it asks the `/data` door's own classifier, `mapDataError(err, objectName)`, and when that door answers a server fault (`isServerFault`), `/actions` answers that door's status, code and sentence. Nothing the throw carried rides along (no `declaredCode`, no `details`); the full text is logged as a `driver fault (CODE): …` operator line.
  - **The predicate that tells the two classes apart**, and where it already lives: `demotedDeclaredCode(resolveThrownHttpError(err, 400)) !== undefined` (`@objectstack/types` `thrown-http-error.ts`). It is the read that put the driver spelling into `/actions`' `declaredCode`, and it is present exactly when the code is not a closed vocabulary member. A closed code (`RECORD_LOCKED`, `PERMISSION_DENIED`) is not demoted, so it stays the rejection. The fault/refusal decision itself is `mapDataError` (`data-error-classification.ts`) plus `isServerFault` (`server-fault-log.ts`), the reads `/data` answers with. ⛔ No copy of either.
  - The module note's arm list gains the new arm (the rejection becomes arm 7), and the ⚠️ paragraph that recorded the `/actions`-vs-`/data` difference is removed, since the difference is gone.
- **`@objectstack/mcp`**: comment only. `errorResultFromThrown`'s ⚠️ paragraph about the driver-code difference now says the two doors agree. No code change: the MCP action tools already answer through `actionsDoorAnswerOf`.

| Thrown inside an action body | `/actions` and MCP `run_action` before | after (= `/data`) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `{ code: 'SQLITE_BUSY' }`, text `SQLITE_BUSY: database is locked` | `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`, the driver text, `declaredCode: SQLITE_BUSY` | `500 DATABASE_ERROR`, `Internal data error` |
| the same from `SqliteError` | same | same |
| `{ code: 'ECONNREFUSED' }`, text `connect ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:5432` | `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`, the text, `declaredCode: ECONNREFUSED` | `500 INTERNAL_ERROR`, `Internal server error` |
| CONTROL: closed code, no status (`RECORD_LOCKED`) | `400 RECORD_LOCKED` | unchanged |
| CONTROL: bare `Error` | `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`, its sentence | unchanged |
| CONTROL: unregistered code with a declared 409 | `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, `declaredCode` | unchanged |
| CONTROL: sandboxed body, unregistered code, no status | `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`, `declaredCode` (`/data` answers 400 too) | unchanged |

## Tests

- New `packages/runtime/src/domains/actions-driver-code-fault-parity.test.ts` (7 rows): §1 three driver rows, one row per door. Each asserts the literal `/actions` wire answer through the real `HttpDispatcher.handleActions`, its equality with `mapDataError` on a fresh copy of the throw, no driver spelling or text anywhere in the body, and the operator line. §2 the four controls above.
- `packages/types/src/actions-door-answer.test.ts`: the driver-string-code row moved from the old 400 answer to the fault answer with its operator line.
- `packages/mcp/src/mcp-coded-refusal.test.ts`: the #31271 `SQLITE_BUSY` case on `run_action` / `resume_run` moved to `500 DATABASE_ERROR` with one operator log line; its block comment updated. The row still asserts equality with `actionsDoorAnswerOf` on a fresh copy.

## Acceptance notes

- **Stated cost.** An in-process (not sandboxed) action handler that throws its own unregistered code with no status, which `/data` also answers as a fault, now gets the fault here and loses the code: the 2026-08-27 ruling on #12509 (the discriminator is the status channel, never the code's spelling). It keeps its code by declaring the status it means. Measured for real callers: the runtime (559 files), mcp (60) and types (38) suites are green with no pin edited beyond the two above; `SANDBOX_AUTHORED_LIMB` (`DUPLICATE`, sandboxed) is untouched because `/data` answers sandboxed coded refusals 400; the sister repo hotcrm's coded refusals all declare a status (`src/sales/objects/_refusal.ts`). No caller found for whom the 400 reading is load-bearing.
- **Not moved: closed codes with no status.** `/data` answers several of these as 500 (`VALIDATION_ERROR`, `RECORD_LOCKED`, `CONFLICT` with no status), `/actions` keeps its 400 with the code, per the order (only the driver-fault class moves). That remaining difference is noted, not filed.
- **Sibling #31330** (seat 6, thread oiz4q5) changes the uncoded `No handler registered` throw in `action-execution.ts`. That throw has no `code`, so the new arm never reads it; whoever lands second merges main and re-reads the other's pins.
- **Superseded changeset line.** The pending `31271` changeset says the driver-code difference between `/actions` and `/data` is not changed; this PR's changeset supersedes that sentence and does not edit it.

## Verification

Head `0b36be09` (base `f4b4c8ae`, `origin/main` `eff90af6` merged once before opening).

Closed codes with no status (`RECORD_LOCKED`, `PERMISSION_DENIED`, `VALIDATION_ERROR`), a bare `Error` and a sandboxed `CREDIT_LIMIT` answered `/actions` 400 with their own code.
- Red first, the new pin on base: `actions-driver-code-fault-parity.test.ts` Tests 3 failed | 4 passed (7), `AssertionError: expected 400 to be 500` (the three §1 rows; §2 controls green). With the fix: 7 passed.
